concerns.text: SC-005 specifies a runtime ceiling (≤ 30 min on a 4‑core CPU) but no task creates, measures, or asserts this performance metric. Add a concrete task (e.g., T030) that times the full pipeline on a 4000‑atom dataset and verifies the elapsed wall‑clock time is ≤ 1800 seconds.

FR-006 requires ≥ 30 independent disorder realizctions per system size, yet no task counts or validates that at least 30 snapshots have been ingested for each of the three sizes. Add a verification task (e.g., T031) that inspects `data/raw/` (or a metadata manifest) and fails if any size has fewer than 30 files.

The plan’s `reference_generator.py` (Task T026) creates thermal‑conductivity values from the same structural data, which conflicts with FR-008’s independence requirement. Either modify the task to source κ from an external, independent dataset or explicitly document how the generated values satisfy independence; otherwise add a task that validates independence before correlation.
